neighbours.label: the verb (or the article right after it) in a locative inversion, where a fronted place phrase comes before the verb and subject: 'Beyond the gate lie ...', 'A mile away is the ...'
fire: Just across the square is the bakery where my grandfather worked.
Behind the old mill stand three tall chestnut trees.
Two streets further on was the school we attended as children.
Above the fireplace hangs a portrait of the first owner.
To the west of the valley rise the snow-covered peaks of the range.
At the end of the corridor is a small library full of maps.
High on the hill sits a ruined castle that tourists love.
A short walk from the station are several cheap hotels.
